name: sidequestd
description: Sidequestd — social video game reviews. Monorepo root.

scripts.infra:reset: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml down -v && npm run infra:up
scripts.api:migrate: cd apps/api && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.api:dev: cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.api:seed: cd apps/api && uv run python -m app.cli.import_games
scripts.api:trending: cd apps/api && uv run python -m app.cli.trending
scripts.api:media: cd apps/api && uv run python -m app.cli.process_media
scripts.api:lint: cd apps/api && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run mypy app
scripts.api:format: cd apps/api && uv run ruff check --fix . && uv run ruff format .
scripts.gen:types: cd apps/api && uv run python -m app.cli.export_openapi ../../packages/api-types/openapi.json && cd ../../packages/api-types && npm run generate
scripts.lint: npm run api:lint && npm run web:lint
scripts.test: npm run api:test && npm run web:test
scripts.format: npm run api:format && npm run format --workspace @sidequestd/web
